mapper.select: SELECT to_regclass('public.user_account') IS NOT NULL AND to_regclass('public.question_bank') IS NOT NULL AND to_regclass('public.practice_result') IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_schema='public' AND table_name='practice_session' AND column_name='configuration_snapshot' AND is_nullable='NO')
SELECT * FROM command_receipt WHERE scope=#{scope} AND operation=#{operation} AND command_id=#{commandId}
SELECT failures,blocked_until FROM login_attempt WHERE scope_digest=#{digest}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO login_attempt(scope_digest,failures,blocked_until) VALUES(#{digest},#{failures},#{until}) ON CONFLICT(scope_digest) DO UPDATE SET failures=excluded.failures,blocked_until=excluded.blocked_until,updated_at=now()

INSERT INTO user_activity(user_id,platform,activity_date) VALUES(#{userId},#{platform},(now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai')::date) ON CONFLICT(user_id,platform,activity_date) DO UPDATE SET last_seen_at=now()
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM audit_log ORDER BY created_at DESC,id LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
